summary: Cambodia renewed its call for Thailand to resume bilateral border demarcation talks and deploy joint survey teams, with government spokesman Pen Bona confirming nine formal requests have been sent to Thailand to convene the Joint Boundary Commission since late December 2025.
title: Cambodia urges Thailand to resume border talks, deploy survey teams

summary: More than 20,000 Cambodian civilians remain displaced in border areas following two rounds of armed clashes between Thai and Cambodian military forces.
title: Over 20,000 Cambodians Remain Displaced Along Thai Border

summary: Interior Minister Sar Sokha proposed reinstating strict traffic law enforcement starting September 1, 2026, due to rising road accidents. The enforcement campaign had previously been suspended due to the Cambodia-Thailand border conflict and global economic challenges.
title: Interior Ministry Proposes Resuming Strict Traffic Law Enforcement from Sept. 1 as Road Accidents Rise

summary: UN Special Rapporteur Thomas Andrews concluded his mission to Cambodia, calling on authorities to protect fundamental freedoms, assist civilians displaced by the border conflict with Thailand, and address cyber scam operations.
title: UN rights expert urges Cambodia to strengthen human rights protections amid border conflict and scam crackdown

summary: A UN human rights expert reported that more than 20,000 Cambodian civilians remain displaced along the Thai border following clashes, with barbed wire and military presence blocking their return.
title: More than 20,000 Cambodians still displaced by Thai clashes, UN expert says

summary: UN Special Rapporteur Tom Andrews reported that over 20,000 Cambodian civilians remain unable to return to their homes near the Thai border, with some villages occupied by Thai military personnel following the 2025 conflict.
title: More than 20,000 Cambodians still displaced by Thai clashes: UN expert

summary: Following a 12-day mission to Cambodia, UN Special Rapporteur Tom Andrews urged both nations to resolve the ongoing displacement of over 20,000 border residents, as Thailand maintained its operations align with ceasefire protocols.
title: Over 20,000 Cambodians remain displaced in border clash with Thailand: UN expert

summary: U.N. Special Rapporteur Tom Andrews stated following meetings in Phnom Penh that over 20,000 Cambodians remain displaced along the border with Thailand due to past conflict, urging both nations to expedite the safe return of civilians.
title: UN expert flags human rights concerns over Cambodia after talks with PM in Phnom Penh

summary: Following Thailand's completion of a reinforced border fence, returning Cambodian migrant workers face severe economic hardship and mounting microloan debts due to job losses, reduced remittances, and disrupted cross-border trade.
title: Cambodian jobseekers fear debt trap over Thailand's border reinforcement

summary: A scholar at the Royal Academy of Cambodia urged Thailand to conduct all humanitarian landmine clearance activities strictly within its own territory and in compliance with existing bilateral agreements, warning against using demining as a pretext for unilateral actions affecting Cambodian sovereignty following pledges by Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul to support border demining.
title: Thailand urged to respect Cambodia's sovereignty in border demining operations

summary: A United Nations expert reported that Cambodia is facing serious human rights challenges, including the displacement of civilians along the border due to ongoing conflict and tensions with Thailand.
title: UN Expert Highlights Severe Human Rights Issues in Cambodia Amid Border Displacement
